split_method: official nuScenes scene split (no scene leakage train<->val)
notes: Baseline is pretrained YOLOv8s (COCO) remapped to nuScenes classes, same official val split.
Largest absolute gains on nuScenes-only classes COCO cannot predict: barrier +0.57, cone +0.57, trailer +0.41 (all from baseline 0.0).
Overall mAP50 averages 23 classes including very rare ones (animal: 4, ambulance: 11, child: 30) that depress the mean; common safety-relevant classes score 0.40-0.73.
Official scene split prevents train/val leakage.
Follows fixes to three pipeline bugs: COCO/nuScenes class-name mismatch in the evaluator, non-standard AP integration, and missing global->ego->camera box projection in loader and converter.
